name: dynamics-connection-compatibility
title: Design the no-SDK Dynamics 365 access gateway
description: Design a shared, no-SDK Dynamics 365 8.2/9.1 Organization access gateway for five current products and future products, including profile-isolated connection-pool ownership, Web API compatibility, and a complete SDK-removal migration boundary.
creator: codex
notes: 2026-08-01 Phase 4 evidence update: D365APP01 read-only Application-log classification found three CE 9.1 WhoAmI failures in CRMWeb Claims non-path-based redirect composition. It exposed no malformed value, so no IFD/AD FS/DNS/IIS/Registry/SQL mutation or repeat WhoAmI is authorized; this is now a CRMWeb product-support/servicing boundary, not a Gateway or Kerberos defect. The fixed LocalDB control plane was provisioned and the opt-in two-owner durable-capacity suite passed 16/16 with both coordinator database-operation counters returning to zero. That is same-process manager/coordinator proof only; true Gateway-plus-Embedded multi-process capacity/fault, CE 8.2/9.1 real-server matrices, and soak/performance/no-leak baselines remain open. Package01FeeReadsEnabled remains false; Phase 5 and Phase 6 remain locked.
